Detailed painted concept-art finish matching reference, crisp readable silhouette, side elevation with slight view into the cup. Canvas square, whole tree centered with generous 10% empty margin all around. Truly transparent alpha background, including between roots; if impossible use perfectly uniform vivid magenta #ff00ff. No landscape, soil platform, fog, floor, floating pieces, outside cast shadow, text, grid or checkerboard. Single complete object only.
